source: Eight confirmed boundaries relayed from the originating version-workflow chat into the consolidated intake chat.
retained: Explicit offline/project decisions; no mandatory planning skill.
Mechanical version edits, independent description authoring, project validation, reviewed commits and execution retain separate responsibilities.
Branch inputs are allowed with exact commit identity; promotion preserves the same artifact.
changes: Clarify independent description/version iteration and no per-Skill commit.
Establish per-target notes policy and source/version/build-injection handoff.
Execute checks required descriptions and evidence, performs the actual workflow and does not repair upstream source by default.
Inspect implicit source edits before execution; isolate project-defined version injection and retain final source/parameter/artifact identity.

version_rationale.bump-version: Patch clarification without new capability or output obligations.
version_rationale.establish-delivery-workflow: Major: required source/version and target-specific description handoff obligations.
version_rationale.execute-delivery-workflow: Major: new prerequisite checks and explicit default source-edit boundary.

scope: No new authoring Skill, version planner, shared release framework or Release Package. No merge, push or actual publication authorized.
